brineking.name: The Brine King
brineking.effect: Cannot be stunned if you were stunned or blocked a stunning hit recently; 30% increased stun and block recovery.

arakaali.name: Arakaali
arakaali.effect: 10% reduced damage taken from damage over time; recovery after taking damage over time stops.

solaris.name: Solaris
solaris.effect: Physical reduction while one enemy is near; a chance to take less area damage from hits.

lunaris.name: Lunaris
lunaris.effect: Movement speed and physical reduction for each nearby enemy, up to 8%.

abberath.name: Abberath
abberath.effect: 60% less ignite duration on you; movement speed on burning ground and immunity to burning ground.

gruthkul.name: Gruthkul
gruthkul.effect: 1% additional physical damage reduction for each hit taken recently, up to 5%.

yugul.name: Yugul
yugul.effect: You and your minions prevent 50% of reflected damage; 50% chance to reflect hexes.

shakari.name: Shakari
shakari.effect: Cannot be poisoned while at least three poisons are on you; 50% less poison duration.

tukohama.name: Tukohama
tukohama.effect: Physical reduction while stationary, up to 9%, plus life regeneration.

ralakesh.name: Ralakesh
ralakesh.effect: Moving while bleeding does not cause extra damage; 25% reduced physical damage over time while moving.

garukhan.name: Garukhan
garukhan.effect: 60% reduced shock effect on you; cannot be blinded.

ryslatha.name: Ryslatha
ryslatha.effect: Life flasks gain charges when unused; more life recovery from flasks at low life.

kraityn.name: Help Kraityn
kraityn.effect: +6% increased Attack Speed, Cast Speed and Movement Speed.
